reason: The README describes a DSH plugin whose primary purpose is integrating subscription-based OAuth and device authorization for four external AI model providers, including token handling, model discovery, and API-backed conversations.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 集成 ChatGPT、Claude、Grok 和 Kimi 订阅账号登录、令牌管理、模型发现及对话调用。
summaries.en: Integrates ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and Kimi subscription authentication, token management, model discovery, and conversation APIs into DSH.

capabilities: OAuth authorization and device-code login with external model providers
Localhost callback handling for authorization flows
Storage and renewal of subscription access tokens through a credential service
Discovery and use of models through ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and Kimi APIs
Registration of authenticated providers and models in DSH
